title: Proportional Analogies on Probability Distributions via Bayesian Updating
abstract: arXiv:2608.11724v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analogies are quaternary relations of the form "A is to B as C is to D". Among the various formalizations of analogical reasoning, proportional analogies provide an important axiomatic framework by characterizing valid analogies through a set of postulates. While proportional analogies have been extensively studied over Boolean, symbolic, and real-valued domains, their extension to probability distributions remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce a notion of proportional analogy for probability distributions based on Bayesian updating. Our approach builds upon the idea that two distributions are related whenever one can be transformed into the other through Bayesian updating induced by a suitable set of observations. We investigate this framework for several standard members of the exponential family and discuss how it naturally extends to arbitrary probability distributions through Gaussian mixture approximations.

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯更新的概率分布比例类比
translated_abstract: 类比是“A之于B如同C之于D”的四元关系。在类比推理的各种形式化方法中，比例类比通过一组公设刻画有效类比，提供了重要的公理化框架。尽管比例类比已在布尔域、符号域和实值域上得到广泛研究，但其在概率分布上的扩展仍 largely 未探索。本文基于贝叶斯更新，引入了一种概率分布的比例类比概念。我们的方法建立在以下思想之上：当两个分布可以通过由适当观测集诱导的贝叶斯更新相互转化时，它们被视为相关。我们针对指数族的几个标准成员研究了该框架，并讨论了如何通过高斯混合近似自然扩展到任意概率分布。
tldr: 本文首次将比例类比扩展到概率分布，利用贝叶斯更新定义分布间的关系，并展示了其在指数族及任意分布上的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first notion of proportional analogy for probability distributions via Bayesian updating, showing its applicability to exponential family members and arbitrary distributions through Gaussian mixture approximations.
